text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Those altocumulus clouds over there...
might be closer to what you were looking for... I think..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you're right. Thanks for finding it!
Um, what else is there—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Cafe-chan is helping me
look for something. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm looking for... fragments of Laurel-san's memories.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you want to know, why not
come along with us? ...Heheh♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Mirrors don't necessarily reflect reality...
When the fountain of the Goddess statue and the mirror overlap, there lies...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wah! How mysterious!
It's reflecting a completely different spring than usual!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
During the twilight hour...
one might encounter strange and mysterious things...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A flock of butterflies...!
I've never seen anything like this before.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The space between the evening and night skies... lasts only a brief moment...
Please, do not blink...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Wow, so pretty...!
To think you knew such a magical place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thanks, Cafe-chan. I had so many encounters today too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So, how about it? Trainer, did you figure out
what we've been searching for?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, spot on♪
choice_data_list: Still, you did well to find it.
Still, impressive that you found it.

text_block_list.text:
A fountain inside a mirror, mysterious butterflies, a fantastical evening sky—
all things that normally, one could never possibly find.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Right! Cafe-chan is
really good at finding things like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I was really surprised at first, you know?
I was just wandering around looking to see if there was anything pink at the academy, and then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Are you... looking for something...?
...If you'd like, please tell me what it looks like..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Is this... an oil painting of pink fruit...?! Amazing, to think it was in a place like this!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“—Finding them in such unexpected places,
and one after another at that.”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...There are quite a few... 'acquaintances' wandering around the academy grounds, so..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huge thanks to your acquaintance too♪ Thanks to them, I get to enjoy so much pink!
choice_data_list: So that's your favorite color, huh?
So that's your favorite color, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes!
After all, it is a very special color to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...When I was a child, my parents used to give me
pink roses every year on my birthday."

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
――Notre magnifique enfant!
You've grown another year older, Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Mother
text_block_list.text: —Seeing you grow up healthy and strong is my greatest joy. Congratulations, truly...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To my young self, those elegant pink roses
looked more beautiful than anything in the world—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: A bouquet of roses and my parents' smiles—that was the greatest gift in the world to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even now, whenever I see pink,
I'm reminded of the warmth in my chest from back then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: That's why having pink close to me gives me the strength to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Even though we're far apart, I feel like... my parents are still cheering me on."
choice_data_list: Laurel being well and healthy is what matters most.
That's a wonderful idea, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Even though we're far apart, I feel like... my parents are still cheering me on."
choice_data_list: Laurel being well and healthy is what matters most.
That's a wonderful idea, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I'm sure my parents
are praying for my growth as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So, surrounded by this color...
I want us to celebrate our birthdays together as a family again!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I agree...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Everyone carries the color of their memories...
And in that regard, I am no different..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When I was young... it was my father
who taught me how to brew coffee.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The endlessly deep black of coffee.
...To me, that is... a truly special color.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well then, if I find a rare black color,
maybe I'll show Cafe-chan the way?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose so...
That doesn't sound bad, either...
